about: Every line the breathing voice speaks, in one place. A line is recorded to public/assets/audio/breathwork/voices/<group>/<id>.mp3 and played by its id, '<group>/<id>'. Stage lines say the same words as the stage text on screen. '...' is a short beat; '[pause 1.5s]' a longer one (a break tag for eleven_multilingual_v2, a [short pause] or [long pause] tag for v3/v4). The speaker is Eleven v4 in the game's own voice, olov-voice: it takes stability and similarity only, so its slow, quiet delivery comes from the tags [thoughtful] [meditative] [deep] (tried on olov-voice in ElevenLabs) and the text's own pauses; with "pauses": "tags" each '...' between words is sent as a [short pause]. Speed, style and speaker boost apply if the model is changed back to eleven_multilingual_v2. The recorder, its settings and the direction: scripts/tts-audio-tracking.md, docs/BREATH_EXPERIENCE_DIRECTION.md.

groups.about: Spoken as a Hale session begins: what it is, what you'll do, and any safety note.

lines.text: Welcome to Hale First Breath. A few quiet minutes to meet the breathing worlds... There's nothing to get right... just follow the light, and my voice.
Welcome to Hale Tide. Five minutes of breathing with the sea... in through the nose as the wave comes in... and out as it slides away.
Welcome to Hale Roots. Five minutes under the old trees... a breath in, a moment of rest... and a long breath out, down into the ground.
Welcome to Hale Unwind. Five minutes to let the day go... the breath out grows longer, the lights grow slower... until you're ready for the night.
Welcome to Hale Sunrise. Four minutes to wake up gently... lively breaths through the nose, light and never forced... then a steady close.

Welcome to Hale Rest, a slow practice for the end of the day. Step by step, we'll learn the four-seven-eight breath... and drift among the stars between rounds. If a hold ever feels like too much... simply breathe.
Welcome to Hale Flow, the geometry of breath. A square... a triangle... and a wider square. After each one the counting stops... and you keep the shape on your own.

Welcome to Hale Base. Three rounds of steady breathing through the nose, each ending in a stillness you hold for as long as it feels good. Sit or lie down... and never practise this in water, or while driving.

Welcome to Hale Elixir, the most active practice. Three rounds of strong breathing through the mouth, each ending in a hold you end yourself. Sit or lie down, never in water or while driving... and if you feel dizzy, slow down.

groups.about: Hale First Breath: the four starter worlds, a taste of each. Same words as the stage text.

lines.text: Sit comfortably... let your shoulders drop... and breathe through your nose, at whatever pace feels easy.
This is the Heart Glow rhythm... five in... and five out... as the lotus opens... and folds.
Now a gentle square... in for four... a soft pause... out for four... and a soft pause.
And now... in for four... and a long, slow breath out... as the moon-path narrows.
Breathe however you like... and notice how you feel.

groups.about: Hale Tide: Ocean Tide's even breath, then a longer ebb. Same words as the stage text.

lines.text: Listen to the water... let your breath find the tide. There's no need to count yet.
In... as the wave runs up the sand... out... as it slides back. Even... and easy.
Now keep the rhythm on your own... let the waves do the counting.
Let each breath out run a little longer... like water drawing back from the shore.
Let the breath come and go on its own... like the tide.

groups.about: Hale Roots: building to Ancient Forest's own rhythm. Same words as the stage text.

lines.text: Feel where your body meets the ground... and let it hold you.
Breathe in... rest a moment at the top... then one long breath out.
Keep breathing this way on your own... and let your body grow a little heavier.
This is the forest's own rhythm... in for four... rest... out for six... and rest again. Roots going down.

groups.about: Hale Unwind: longer out-breaths, then Aurora Dreams' rhythm, then sleep. Same words as the stage text.

lines.text: Let your jaw soften... let your hands rest. Nothing needs doing now.
Breathe in gently... and let a longer breath out... like a quiet sigh.
This is the aurora's rhythm... in for five... rest... a long breath out for seven... and rest. Let the lights fall with you.
Let the breath slow down on its own... there's nowhere you need to be.

groups.about: Hale Sunrise: Solar Flare's brisk rhythm, then quicker and lighter. Same words as the stage text.

lines.text: Sit tall... let your shoulders open... and let the light find you.
This is the Solar Flare rhythm... in for three... a short pause... out for three. Brisk... and even.
Quicker now... light breaths through the nose. If you feel light-headed... simply breathe normally.
Breathe however feels good... and notice the warmth... how awake you feel.

groups.about: Hale Rest: Moonlit Waters' four-seven-eight learned step by step, drifting in Cosmic Nebula, then sleep. Same words as the stage text.

lines.text: Let your body grow heavy... let the day soften. There's nothing left to do tonight.
In through the nose for four... and out, slowly, for eight... let the moon-path narrow with you.
No counting now... just float... and keep the breath long and slow.
Now rest at the top... in for four... hold softly for four... and out for eight.
Float again, on your own... there's no hurry.
This is the Moonlit Waters rhythm... in for four... hold for seven... out for eight. If the hold feels long, breathe whenever you need.
Let the breath find its own way... and drift.

groups.about: Hale Flow: Sacred Geometry's square, Crystal Prism's triangle, a wider square. Same words as the stage text.

lines.text: Notice your heartbeat... and let it bring you here.
Four equal sides... in for four... hold for four... out for four... hold for four.
Keep the square going on your own... let the light draw it.
Now three sides... in for four... out for four... and rest for four... as the light fans into colour... and gathers.
On your own now... in... out... and rest.
Widen the square... five in... hold for five... five out... hold for five. Slow... and even.
Keep it going on your own... steady... and balanced.
Let the shape dissolve... and breathe however you like.

groups.about: Hale Base: steady nasal breathing in Electric Storm, holds you end yourself. Same words as the stage text.

lines.text: Close your eyes... scan your body from head to toe... and let each breath out soften what you find.
Breathe in through the nose... belly, then chest... and let it go. A steady rhythm... full, never forced.
Stay here... nothing to do. When you need to breathe... breathe in.
Breathe all the way in... and hold it... let the breath fill you.
A little quicker now... belly rises... chest opens... and let it go.
Rest in the stillness... and simply watch.
Breathe in fully... and hold... let the breath reach every part of you.
Quicker still... full breaths, never forced. Tingling is normal... ease off if you need to.
Silent... and still... notice the space between your thoughts.
One full breath in... and hold it gently at the top.
Return to your natural breath... there's nothing to do... simply be.

groups.about: Hale Elixir: Volcanic Fire's power breathing through the mouth, deep holds you end yourself. Same words as the stage text.

lines.text: Breathe through your nose for now... slow and easy... and let your body settle before we begin.
Through the mouth now... fully in... and let it go. In... and out... a steady loop.
Rest here, in the silence. When you need to breathe... breathe in.
Breathe all the way in... and hold it at the top.
A little faster... in... and out... connected breaths, with no pause between them.
Deep silence... notice what you feel... without judging it.
Breathe in fully... and hold... squeeze gently at the top.
Full and free... tingling is normal... if you feel dizzy, slow down.
Complete release... you are held. Breathe in whenever you need.
One deep breath in... and hold... let the energy rise.
Let the breath settle on its own... allow whatever arises... you are complete.

groups.about: The twelve breathing worlds: an introduction spoken as a world begins in the Breathing tab, and the world's cue words (spoken in sessions and practice once the plain cues have taught the rhythm). For the breath in and out, its own couplet (_in, _out) and four more (_in_2/_out_2 ...): a couplet is spoken together. For its pauses, where its rhythm has them, words for the hold with the lungs full (_hold ...) and the rest with them empty (_rest ...). The words are written in breath-catalogue.js (cues, moreCues, holdCues, restCues), which the guide shows. Kept in line by npm run tts:cues.

lines.text: Aurora Dreams. A long breath out, under the northern lights... follow it all the way down.
Sacred Geometry. Four equal sides... in, hold, out, hold... four counts each. A breath for focus.
Moonlit Waters. In for four... hold for seven... out for eight. A breath for falling asleep.
Let it fade to a thread...
Let it sink into the water...
Let the light rest on the water...
Solar Flare. Brisk and even... in for three... out for three. A breath to wake you up.
Heart Glow. Five in... five out... with no pauses. The lotus opens as you breathe in... and folds as you breathe out.
Crystal Prism. Three sides... in... out... and rest. A breath for a clear mind.
Volcanic Fire. Quick, full breaths... the strongest rhythm of all. Sit down for it... and stop if you feel dizzy.
Ocean Tide. A wave in... a wave out. Nothing to count... just follow the water.
Zen Garden. Slow breaths... with quiet pauses at each end. A breath for stillness.
Cosmic Nebula. Wide, even breaths... with room to float in every pause.
Ancient Forest. In for four... a short rest... and a longer breath out. A breath that brings you back to the ground.
Let it settle on the moss...
Let it sink to the roots...
Electric Storm. A charged rhythm... in for three... hold... and a longer breath out. A breath to sharpen you.

groups.about: Between stages: the start of each round, the start of a hold, the rest, and the hold bell's invitation.

lines.text: Let the last breath go... and hold, with empty lungs.
Let go of the rhythm now... and rest.

groups.about: Fourteen seconds before a session ends. Same words as the closing text on screen.

lines.text: Let the breath deepen a little... move your fingers and toes... and open your eyes when you're ready.
Stay just as you are... there's nothing more to do... let sleep come.

groups.about: A word partway through a round, and thanks in the rest.

lines.text: Thank yourself for this practice... for showing up.
Be proud of yourself... you showed up today.

groups.about: Spread through a session's rest, the last one well before the closing.

lines.text: You might feel a tingling... a lightness... just let it be there.
Thoughts may come and go... like clouds... you don't have to follow them.
Stay here as long as you need.
You are safe... you are held... you are home.
There is nothing to do... nowhere to go... simply be.
Scan your body... notice what you feel... and let it be as it is.
Like waves in the ocean... rising... and falling... endlessly.
With each breath out... let go a little more.
A warm light glows within you... a little brighter with each breath.
Let your body breathe for you now... it knows how.
You are complete... you are whole... exactly as you are.
Let each thought drift away... like a cloud across the moon.

groups.about: One per choice on a session's preparation screen: spoken there when chosen, and after the session's arrival.

lines.text: Let the sea bring you calm.
Get ready for a good night's sleep.
Prepare for sleep... and let it come.
